parts.label: left caterpillar track
parts.appearance: elongated capsule-shaped continuous track with a thick tread loop, rounded ends and an inset row of circular rollers, mounted along the left side at the bottom

parts.label: right caterpillar track
parts.appearance: elongated capsule-shaped continuous track with a thick tread loop and inset rollers, mounted along the right side parallel to the left track

parts.label: central undercarriage frame
parts.appearance: low thick rectangular cross frame bridging the two parallel tracks, with a raised circular hub centered above it

parts.label: rotating upper platform
parts.appearance: wide low horizontal rounded rectangular platform with a curved rear edge, centered above the undercarriage hub

parts.label: operator cabin
parts.appearance: tall rectangular enclosure with rounded roof corners, thin framed large flat window panels and a slightly sloping front face, rising from the left side of the platform

parts.label: rear counterweight
parts.appearance: thick rounded rectangular block with a curved outer back and beveled upper edges, mounted behind the cabin across the rear of the platform

parts.label: main boom
parts.appearance: thick bent elongated rectangular beam rising diagonally forward from the platform before extending forward almost horizontally, with large circular pivot lugs at both ends

parts.label: forearm stick
parts.appearance: long tapered rectangular beam descending nearly vertically from an upper circular pivot lug, with a short projecting extension above the pivot and a forked lower end

parts.label: digging bucket
parts.appearance: wide hollow curved scoop with thick curved side plates, open toward the machine, a straight lower cutting edge and paired attachment lugs at the upper rear

parts.label: left bucket tooth
parts.appearance: short thick tapered wedge projecting diagonally down and forward from the left end of the bucket cutting edge

parts.label: middle bucket tooth
parts.appearance: short thick tapered wedge projecting diagonally down and forward from the middle of the bucket cutting edge

parts.label: right bucket tooth
parts.appearance: short thick tapered wedge projecting diagonally down and forward from the right end of the bucket cutting edge
